note: All rows are PREPARED checks, not earned play. Save = completed camp prepared in-page from the recorded earned completion (sequel-progression-checks.json; raw earned save not available in this environment), reloaded through migration; threat written into the save; raid started with the visible button; real time; no player assistance. Wave4 crew = recorded completion crew (arch 3 + arch 3 + ballista 3 [armour], recorded anchors). Wave9: the recorded crew (6/6/3) only won with click assistance and loses unassisted even at threat 0, so the Wave9 baseline is a full four-slot crew of the same camp (arch 10 + arch 10 + ballista 6 [armour] + sword 6). Flank road/boss seed = wave number (in play it is the run number).

name: 群れ増加
Larger packs
鼠群增多
note: ネズミと俊足が1.5倍、間を詰めて来る
1.5× rats and runners, packed closer
老鼠和迅捷鼠×1.5，间隔更密

name: 鉄の毛皮
Iron hide
铁皮
note: 鎧ネズミの鎧+2、ネズミにも鎧1
Armoured rats +2 armour; rats gain armour 1
铁甲鼠护甲+2，老鼠也有护甲1
decide: 剣士・バリスタの比率と優先目標
Swords/ballistas vs archers, and target priority
剑士·弩炮的比例与优先目标

name: 急襲
Rush
突袭
note: 準備時間が30秒短い
30 s less preparation time
准备时间缩短30秒
decide: 自動化に先に投資するか

name: 薄い備え
Thin stores
物资稀薄
note: 物資箱2つで始まる
Start each raid with 2 crates
每波只有2个物资箱
decide: 取りこぼしを許さない配置
不放过任何敌人的布阵

name: 狭い陣地
Cramped camp
阵地狭窄
note: 防衛部隊の枠が1つ封鎖（3枠）
One defence slot is sealed (3 slots)
封锁1个防守部队位置（3个）

name: 片寄り
Flanking
偏路
note: 俊足が片方の道に集まり、増える（予告あり）
Runners mass on one road, with extras (forecast)
迅捷鼠集中到一条路并增加（有预告）

name: 夜の羽音
Night wings
夜翼
note: 夜コウモリが毎回飛んで来る
Night bats join every raid
每波都有夜蝠飞来
decide: 倉庫寄りに弓兵を残す

name: 盾の列
Shield wall
盾阵
note: 盾持ちネズミが列の先頭に並ぶ
Shield rats lead every column
持盾鼠在队伍前排
decide: 盾を割る剣士・バリスタを前に
Swords/ballistas up front to break shields
把能破盾的剑士·弩炮放在前面

name: 地中から
From below
地底来袭
note: 穴掘りモグラが道の中ほどを潜って来る
Burrowing moles tunnel under mid-road
掘地鼹鼠从道路中段地下穿过
decide: 曲がり角の近くを守る

name: 祈祷の行列
Prayer procession
祈祷队列
note: 祈祷ネズミが列の中で味方を回復する
Rat shamans heal the column as it walks
鼠巫在队伍中为同伴回复
decide: バリスタの方針を回復役に
Set a ballista to Healers first
把弩炮方针设为优先治疗者

name: 攻城
Siege
攻城
note: 攻城荷車と石投げが来る（Wave4から荷車）
Siege carts and slingers (carts from raid 4)
攻城车与投石鼠来袭（第4波起有攻城车）
decide: 前に届く射程と鎧貫通
能打到前方的射程与穿甲
